#: Regular expression matching valid SemVer strings
_REGEX = re.compile(
        r"""
        ^
        (?P<major>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<minor>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        \.
        (?P<patch>(?:0|[1-9][0-9]*))
        (\-(?P<prerelease>
            (?:[0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)
        ))?
        (\+(?P<build>
            [0-9A-Za-z-]+(\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*
        ))?
        $
        """, re.VERBOSE)
